description: ONS publishes vector boundaries of hydrographic basins containing hydropower developments in Brazil's interconnected electricity system. The provider describes a Shapefile distribution supplied as an archive. These geographic outlines support catchment-to-hydropower mapping and spatial preparation of reservoir-network models. They are basin geometry, not measured river flow, reservoir operating rules or a complete directed river network. The metadata does not establish the coordinate reference system, geometric accuracy or survey date. Coverage is basins with hydropower developments in the SIN in Brazil. The catalogue lists a Shapefile archive; files are free under the provider's CC-BY terms, with no version specified. ONS requires attribution and disclosure of changes. Data contents were not downloaded; completeness is unknown, and published values may be revised. Related ONS generation-by-plant data provide a comparison series.
